CandidateFeatures.description:
Everything we know about a candidate place, aggregated. We never see raw
POI-level data here, just the rolled-up numbers.
CandidateFeatures.title: CandidateFeatures

CatalogEntry.description:
One managed destination as the Core API stores it: the raw provider numbers,
not densities. The densities are worked out over the whole list on arrival
(engine/enrich.py normalize_entries), so adding a city never needs the other
rows rewritten.
CatalogEntry.title: CatalogEntry

ClimateNormals.description:
Monthly averages keyed '1'..'12'. Comes from Open-Meteo for the offline
seed data - not the same as the live OpenWeather forecast the app shows
elsewhere (see enrich_destinations.py for why we use two different weather
APIs here).
ClimateNormals.title: ClimateNormals

EnrichRequest.description: Where a destination is. The Core API sends the admin's own entry.
EnrichRequest.title: EnrichRequest

EvidenceEntry.description: one scoring dimension's contribution to the total, plus why it got that score
EvidenceEntry.title: EvidenceEntry

MemberFit.description: How one traveller in the group scores this candidate on their own.
MemberFit.title: MemberFit

info.description: Recommendation engine, landmarks, translation, weather and exchange rates.
info.title: Roamio Expert & Integration Service

get.description:
Which features this instance can actually serve, for the administrator
health view (FR-25). Reports whether each key is set, never its value.

get.description:
Is this named place within reach of the trip? Used by the trip assistant when it
adds a stop (FR-37). found=false is an answer, not an error.
